endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: id_usfs_aw_washington_creek_campground_access_anchor_20260918 american-whitewater-washington-creek-campground-access-fr247-mile-42-7: American Whitewater identifies Washington Creek Campground Access at Forest Road 247 mile 42.7 and places the paddler access on the upstream river-right side of the bridge to the campground; it supports both the Weitas-to-Washington take-out and Washington-to-Quartz put-in. The current USFS Recreation Opportunities layer identifies Washington Creek Campground and describes river access along the campground's full length. The stored point is the named campground locality/approach anchor, not a published surveyed launch coordinate; imagery places it inland from mapped water, and neither source georeferences the carry or landing toe. Retain the location as an access-site anchor and keep the exact launch under review.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (id_usfs_aw_washington_creek_campground_access_anchor_20260918 american-whitewater-washington-creek-campground-access-fr247-mile-42-7) on North Fork Clearwater River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point.
